title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1968-08-28
source: AUD UNKNOWN LINEAGE > REEL > EDIROL USB UA-1EX AUDIO INTERFACE > COOL EDIT > CD WAVE EDITOR > TRADERS LITTLE HELPER > FLAC

ai_review.summary: A solid audience recording of a primal 1968 Dead show, highlighted by the classic Pig riff in the second set and a rare Good Morning Little Schoolgirl.
ai_review.review: The three reviewers agree that this AUD capture is among the best‑sounding versions of the night despite the inevitable lo‑fi character of 1968 audience tapes. The performance is described as “primal Dead” playing psychedelic highlights, with the standout moments being the iconic Pig riff and a unique rendition of Good Morning Little Schoolgirl, while the missing first set leaves some mystery about the full flow.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are positive (4‑star) and consistently praise both the musical performance and the relative quality of this audience recording, giving a clear consensus.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Not pristine by modern standards but considered the best sounding version available; clear enough for an AUD from 1968 with acceptable fidelity and no major drop‑outs reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The recording is missing the first set, but the available material showcases a high‑energy, psychedelic second set with classic Dead motifs; the encore features the rare Schoolgirl performance.
